name: Fairchild 660
notes: Probed 2026-11-23. Threshold (0-10) and Time Constant (1-6) are Fairchild controls: they carry between the 660 and 670 only. The input steps come back as you left them when you return to the 660.
Threshold, Output and Mix report raw knob numbers and are read through a measured table. Power stands in for the compressor's in/out.
